description: Read one place from Google Places by its id, in the shape a wording's place takes in create_poll and update_poll: its name, kind (country, region, county, city or postal_code) and ISO country and region codes. Any other place, such as an address or a business, is refused. Models never see a wording's place; it is there so results can be shown by place. (GET /api/v1/places/{id})

id.description: A Google place id, from search_places.

session.description: Optional: one UUID you make for a search and the read that follows it, which Google bills as one session.

name: get_place
title: Get a place
